aapravasi_ghat.name: Aapravasi Ghat
aapravasi_ghat.hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–16:00 · Sat 09:00–12:00 · closed Sunday; check on the day
aapravasi_ghat.tip: This UNESCO site marks where indentured labourers first arrived. Start with the short film, then walk the stone steps to the water.

central_market.name: Port Louis Central Market
central_market.price_text: Free to enter; food and produce priced per item
central_market.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 06:00–17:30 · Sunday morning only; check on the day
central_market.tip: Come hungry for dholl puri and alouda. Bring small notes and expect friendly bargaining.

labourdonnais.name: Chateau de Labourdonnais
labourdonnais.price_text: Entry fee varies by ticket type; check on the day
labourdonnais.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00; check on the day
labourdonnais.tip: Pair the colonial house tour with the orchard and rum tasting. Allow extra time for the gardens.

eureka_house.name: Eureka House
eureka_house.price_text: Entry fee; check on the day
eureka_house.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00; check on the day
eureka_house.tip: A creole mansion with period furniture and a garden waterfall. Good for a quiet hour away from the city.

ganga_talao.name: Ganga Talao (Grand Bassin)
ganga_talao.price_text: Free entry; small parking fee may apply
ganga_talao.hours: Open daily daylight hours; temple areas may close for rituals
ganga_talao.tip: A sacred lake with temples. Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering shrines.
ganga_talao.best: Early morning; busy at Maha Shivaratri

casela.name: Casela World of Adventures
casela.price_text: Entry plus paid activities; check current packages on the day
casela.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00; check on the day
casela.tip: Book activities online ahead. The park is big, so pick two or three experiences rather than trying everything.

dholl_puri.name: Dholl Puri
dholl_puri.price_text: Cheap street food; a few tens of MUR per portion
dholl_puri.tip: Mauritius's classic street snack: flatbread with split peas, curry and chilli. Ask for less chilli if unsure.

mauritius.name: Mauritius
mauritius.tip: Use Port Louis as a base for the north and centre. The south and west coasts need a full day each.
mauritius.best: May to November for drier, cooler days

caudan_waterfront.name: Caudan Waterfront
caudan_waterfront.price_text: Free to walk; shops and cafes priced separately
caudan_waterfront.tip: A easy waterfront stroll with harbour views, shops and the blue penny museum nearby.

citadel_fort.name: Fort Adelaide (La Citadelle)
citadel_fort.price_text: Free entry; small fee may apply for some areas
citadel_fort.hours: Daily daylight hours; check on the day
citadel_fort.tip: Climb to the fort for one of the best views over the city and harbour. Go early or near sunset.

champ_de_mars.name: Champ de Mars Racecourse
champ_de_mars.price_text: Race-day entry varies; check on the day
champ_de_mars.hours: Race days only; check the calendar
champ_de_mars.tip: One of the oldest racecourses in the southern hemisphere. Check race dates before you go.

blue_penny.name: Blue Penny Museum
blue_penny.price_text: Entry fee; check on the day
blue_penny.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 10:00–17:00; check on the day
blue_penny.tip: See the famous Blue Penny and Red Penny stamps. A good indoor stop on a hot or rainy day.

chinatown_walk.name: Chinatown and city-centre walk
chinatown_walk.price_text: Free self-guided; guided tours priced separately
chinatown_walk.hours: Daylight hours; busiest on weekday mornings
chinatown_walk.tip: Wander the streets around the market for temples, food stalls and old shopfronts. Keep valuables close.

le_caudan_view.name: Harbour viewpoint at Caudan
le_caudan_view.tip: Watch the boats and the city skyline. Best light is late afternoon.

street_food_tour.name: Port Louis street-food tasting
street_food_tour.price_text: Guided tours priced per person; check on the day
street_food_tour.tip: A guided tasting covers dholl puri, gateaux piments and alouda. Confirm meeting point and what is included.

jummah_mosque.name: Jummah Mosque
jummah_mosque.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
jummah_mosque.tip: A historic mosque in the city centre. Dress modestly and avoid visiting during prayers.

natural_history_museum.name: Natural History Museum
natural_history_museum.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 09:00–16:00; check on the day
natural_history_museum.tip: Home to the dodo skeleton and island natural history. A short, free indoor stop.

photography_museum.name: Photography Museum
photography_museum.price_text: Entry fee; check on the day
photography_museum.tip: Small museum on the history of photography in Mauritius. Good for a quiet half hour.

alouda_stall.name: Alouda drink stall
alouda_stall.price_text: Cheap; a few tens of MUR per glass
alouda_stall.tip: A sweet milk drink with basil seeds and jelly. Try it cold on a hot day.

waterfront_dining.name: Waterfront restaurants
waterfront_dining.hours: Lunch and dinner; some open late
waterfront_dining.tip: Good for a relaxed dinner with harbour views. Book ahead on weekends.

city_market_shopping.name: Craft and textile shopping near the market
city_market_shopping.price_text: Free to browse; goods priced per item
city_market_shopping.tip: Look for textiles, spices and souvenirs. Compare prices before buying.
